name: Remote Receiver → On Drayton
description: An automation to perform when a Drayton Digistat RF code has been decoded. A variable `x` of type <APIStruct text="remote_base::DraytonData" path="remote_base::DraytonData" /> is passed to the automation for use in lambdas. It has the fields `address`, `data`, and the legacy `channel` and `command`. Packets that fail the checksum are dropped and do not trigger the automation.
